headline: Palmer Recalled, test1 On Warning Too
deck: Tuchel recalls Palmer, owned by test1, and Alexander-Arnold, with a warning that players must perform.
body:
Cole Palmer is back in the England fold, and test1 will note the caveat that came with him. Tuchel recalled the midfielder alongside Trent Alexander-Arnold, then made plain that a place in the squad guarantees nothing beyond it. Selection is not the same as trust, and test1 owns a player Tuchel wants to see earn his.

For test3331 there is nothing here to read. Thomas remains theirs, and the recall list did not trouble him one way or the other. Two owners watched the same announcement; only one of them found their name in it.
